prompts.prompt: 58-year-old woman with a mild age-related nuclear cataract in the right eye. Slowly dimming vision over a year and needing more light to read.
70-year-old man with a moderate age-related nuclear cataract in the right eye. Gradually blurred distance vision over two years and colours look yellowed.
82-year-old woman with a dense brunescent nuclear cataract in the left eye. Severe painless loss of vision over several years and she can no longer read or recognise faces.
62-year-old man with an early cortical cataract in the right eye, with spokes in the inferior peripheral lens. Mild glare from headlights at night, with reading vision still good.
74-year-old woman with an advanced cortical cataract in the left eye, with spokes reaching the visual axis. Marked glare and blurred vision in bright light.

prompts.description: Posterior subcapsular cataract in a young steroid user
prompts.prompt: 38-year-old man with a posterior subcapsular cataract in the right eye after years of oral steroids for asthma. Glare, and poor reading vision that is worse in bright light.
52-year-old woman with long-standing diabetes and a posterior subcapsular cataract in the left eye. Reading has become difficult over six months and she is dazzled by sunlight.

prompts.description: Mixed cataract (nuclear, cortical and posterior subcapsular)
prompts.prompt: 76-year-old man with a mixed age-related cataract in the right eye, with moderate nuclear, cortical and posterior subcapsular changes. Blurred vision at all distances, with glare at night.
80-year-old woman with a mature white cataract in the left eye. The pupil looks white and she can only see hand movements in that eye.
35-year-old man with a traumatic cataract in the right eye, with a rosette-shaped opacity, six months after a blunt injury from a squash ball. Blurred vision in that eye since the injury.
9-year-old girl with a congenital anterior polar cataract in the right eye, a small white plaque on the front of the lens in the pupillary area. No symptoms, found at a school screening.
29-year-old man with a posterior polar cataract in the left eye, a round white plaque at the back of the lens on the visual axis. Glare and blur in bright light, and his father had the same.
7-year-old boy with a lamellar cataract in both eyes, a hazy shell around a clear centre with riders at the edge. Poor vision in class, worse when the pupils are wide.
Three-month-old girl with a dense congenital cataract in the right eye. Her mother noticed a white pupil in photographs and the eye does not fix on faces.
24-year-old woman with a sutural cataract in the left eye, fine Y-shaped opacities in the lens. Found at a routine eye test, with 6/6 vision and no symptoms.
31-year-old man with blue-dot cataracts in the right eye, many small blue-white dots scattered through the lens. Found at a routine eye test, with no symptoms.
Two-year-old boy with a congenital rubella cataract in the left eye, a dense pearly white nucleus. His mother had rubella in early pregnancy, and he has a small eye and a heart murmur.
Five-week-old girl with galactosemia and oil-droplet cataracts in both eyes. She is vomiting and jaundiced and has been feeding on milk formula.
Four-month-old boy with persistent fetal vasculature in the right eye. White pupil, a small eye and a retrolental white plaque with a stalk reaching the back of the lens.
19-year-old woman with poorly controlled type 1 diabetes and a snowflake cataract in the right eye, with white flakes across the lens. Vision dropped over a few weeks.

45-year-old woman with a hypocalcaemic cataract in the left eye after thyroid surgery, with fine multicoloured crystals and flecks under the lens capsule. Blurred vision for four months, and muscle cramps.
27-year-old man with Wilson disease and a sunflower cataract in the right eye, a petalled disc of copper-coloured deposits under the front of the lens. Vision is good.

41-year-old man with myotonic dystrophy and a posterior subcapsular cataract in the left eye with bright multicoloured dots (Christmas-tree appearance). Drooping eyelids, and he cannot release his grip.
22-year-old man with severe atopic dermatitis and a shield cataract in the right eye, a plaque on the front of the lens. Itchy red eyelids, and blurred vision for a year.
34-year-old woman with juvenile idiopathic arthritis and chronic anterior uveitis, with a complicated cataract in the left eye. Posterior synechiae, a small irregular pupil and blurred vision.

68-year-old woman with a cataract in the right eye and white anterior subcapsular flecks (glaukomflecken) after an attack of acute angle-closure glaucoma two months ago. The pupil is mid-dilated and oval.
78-year-old woman with a swollen, white intumescent cataract in the left eye. Shallow anterior chamber, a red eye with a headache, and the pressure is raised.
86-year-old man with a hypermature Morgagnian cataract in the right eye, a milky liquefied cortex with the brown nucleus sunk to the bottom. He has had very poor vision for many years.
82-year-old woman with a hypermature cataract in the left eye and phacolytic glaucoma. White lens material leaks into a cloudy anterior chamber, the eye is red and painful, and the pressure is high.
76-year-old man with pseudoexfoliation and a nuclear cataract in the right eye. White flaky material on the pupil edge and anterior lens, a poorly dilating pupil and a trembling lens.
48-year-old woman with pathological myopia of about -12 dioptres and a nuclear cataract in the left eye. A myopic shift that keeps getting stronger, and a long eye.
44-year-old man with retinitis pigmentosa and a posterior subcapsular cataract in the right eye. Night blindness since adolescence, and now glare and worse central vision.

intended.diagnosis: Posterior subcapsular cataract in retinitis pigmentosa

prompts.prompt: 63-year-old man who worked as a glassblower for 40 years and has an infrared cataract in the left eye, with a posterior subcapsular opacity and a peeling front capsule. Blurred vision for two years.
57-year-old woman with a radiation cataract in the right eye, 5 years after radiotherapy for an orbital tumour. A posterior subcapsular opacity at the back of the lens, getting worse.
28-year-old electrician with an anterior subcapsular cataract in the left eye, 8 months after a high-voltage electrical injury to the head. Blurring and spots in his vision.
66-year-old woman with severe COPD, years of high-dose inhaled steroids and a posterior subcapsular cataract in the right eye. Glare from headlights, and she cannot read in bright light.
59-year-old man on chlorpromazine for 20 years with fine brown-yellow granules on the front of the lens in the left eye in a stellate pattern. Vision is mildly reduced.
69-year-old man with a fast-growing nuclear cataract in the right eye, 14 months after a vitrectomy for a macular hole. Blurred distance vision and colours look brown.

72-year-old woman with posterior capsule opacification in the left eye, three years after cataract surgery with an intraocular lens. Pearl-like and wrinkled capsule haze behind the lens, with blurred vision and glare.

prompts.description: Mature cataract in dark skin and a dark brown iris
prompts.prompt: 67-year-old man of West African descent with dark skin and dark brown irides, and a mature brunescent cataract in the right eye. A slowly worsening dark haze in the pupil over five years.
